items.period: Small seal script style; modern digital drawing uploaded 2007
items.caption: A modern rendering of 行 in Shuowen seal-script style, useful as a later comparison for the character’s graphic history.
items.alt: Modern SVG drawing of 行 in a rounded small-seal style.
items.selection_reason: Exact Commons file page identifies the character, gives a direct original-file link, and states public-domain release. It is a clear later-script comparison, though not an ancient artifact image.
items.rights: Public domain as released by the creator per Commons file description.

limitations.text: Did not select a Shang oracle-bone image: although Commons lists an oracle-script version as a related file, this pass did not inspect its exact description page and provenance. The chosen seal image alone cannot illustrate the earliest graphic form.
